observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black compact digital camera. The lens is silver with 'LEICA' and 'DC VARIO-ELMARIT' visible. The body has 'LUMIX' branding, '29mm Wide Angle', '3.0" LCD', '12 MEGA PIXELS', and a red 'iA' icon.
Photo 1: Top view of the camera. The model number 'DMC-FZ25' is visible on the top right. The brand 'Panasonic' is printed on the top left. Power switch and mode dial are visible.
